public_observation_contract: Learners see only (public o_t, public binary action_t, public next o_t), no generator state, family ID, phase label or hidden future; 32 transitions/episode, each episode resets learner state.

families.FIT_A_BINARY_ACTION_SWITCH: Latent binary s0 fair; current action0 flips s with .06 and action1 flips with .66; observation public Bernoulli bit equal s with accuracy .85; action iid fair.
families.FIT_B_BINARY_LAG_EFFECT: Latent binary s0 fair; if previous public action1 and current public action0 flip .64 else flip .10; sensor accuracy .82; action iid fair; lagged causal dependence misspecified by O13 direct-current-only transitions.
families.XFER_C_THREE_STATE_CYCLE: Structurally withheld latent ternary s0 uniform0..2. Public action0 advances hidden +1 mod3 with .88 chance, action1 advances hidden +2 mod3 with .88 chance, else state unchanged; public next bit equals int(s==2) with .90 reliability. No fit/select episode from this family.
families.XFER_D_COUPLED_BIT_MEMORY: Structurally withheld pair of hidden bits (u,v), each initially fair. Public action0 flips u with .72, action1 flips v with .72; independent observation noise accuracy .86 on emitted XOR(u,v). No fit/select episode from this family.
families.XFER_NULL_IID: Public binary observations iid fair and actions iid fair. No information in history, included as false-positive and overfit control; no fit/select episode from this family.

frozen_fit: Concatenate interleaved 24 FIT_A and 24 FIT_B TRAIN episodes A0,B0,A1,B1... (48 total); FIT_SELECT similarly 8+8 interleaved. Fit nothing on INDOMAIN_DEV or ZERO_SHOT_TRANSFER.

evaluation.primary: All eight arms × FIVE INDOMAIN/TRANSFER family mean PUBLIC next-bit NLL and role SHA256 (two INDOMAIN + two STRUCTURAL transfer + NULL); lower NLL better.

evaluation.ablation: Original full vs exact stop; exact full state erasure vs trained full checkpoint; NULL fixed 0.5 calibration.

Synthetic public results cannot independently authorize any FSA scientific GO.
